construction.review_rule: Generated anchor-based candidates were treated only as locators. Frozen source was inspected before these witnesses were committed; behavior ownership and required regions were corrected manually where necessary.

known_candidate_corrections.reason: Generated region covered RouteParams.Add (storage), while the task asks for retrieval from request routing context. Frozen witness moved to URLParam/URLParamFromCtx.
Generated region covered protocol/trust-proxy behavior, while the task asks for request IP computation. Frozen witness moved to the ip getter and proxyaddr call.
Function ownership alone did not expose the missing/None-safe authenticator handling, so a second required implementation region was added.

The generated region exposed only the function head/explicit-file path. The task is about destination selection, so explicit, default-destination, and loading-precedence branches are frozen separately.
The health-check interval gate and PING/PONG operation are separate behavior-bearing regions, so both are required.

tasks.prompt: Locate the production source file responsible for duplicate-key handling, including null values, in Gson map deserialization. Return the most relevant production file path.
